registration: Freeze before either terminal-intake result. Original evidence scopes remain exposed training maps. No deployed candidate, ladder game, parent weight update, hyperparameter sweep, or exam.

assignment.prohibition: 463 must not enter gradient, threshold choice, feature design, or refitting. Freeze the model and publish all eligible full-menu prediction probabilities before consuming the 463 terminal-return label. A later-arriving 463 menu is scored before loading its label, under the already frozen hash.

eligibility: Only previously registered complete terminal-intake branch pairs with same pre-state and genuine same root examiner call, genuine A, verified paid focal economic A-vs-B contrast, complete healthy clocks and required native search depths, independent official terminal settlement on both paths per intake protocol. Retain all incomplete, invalid or missing pairs with reason. Match A and B distinctly in pre-root full physical support with probabilities >0; no new order/action/outcome substitution.
target: A is natural 851c command, B is selected alternate. d = U(B)-U(A), recomputed from candidate-seat official scores including extinction, U=.5*(win+.5*draw)+.5*sigmoid(margin/1000). Exactly one natural rollout per arm. Do not infer population advantage.
features: Use pre-request causal 851c own Feat/aux and trained Sapling GRU hidden[1] (96, paired it50 is [0]); teacher-force each full physical order through the same true legal prefix; aggregate h for each selected canonical worker action NONE/UP/RIGHT/DOWN/LEFT or base action NONE/RECCOLLECTOR/RECPLANTER separately into 8x96, divided by active slots. Normalize phi by max(1,l2norm(phi)). The official receipt, subsequent action, economy outcome, native opponent action/identity, fit/transfer seed, seat labels and opponent private state never enter the score.
model: 768 shared float64 readout parameters theta initialized to zero. Full physical menu scores are log(p_behavior(a|s))+dot(theta,phi(s,a)); normalize by softmax over exactly the full unique frozen physical support. Baseline probability uses cross-class marginal. At zero theta recover the prior. This experimental head is independent of the deployed 851c.
update: When the 462 pair is eligible and d!=0, minimize |d| log(1+exp(-sign(d) * theta·(phiB-phiA))) at theta=0 with exactly one learning-rate .25 gradient step. Equivalently theta_raw=.125*d*(phiB-phiA). Project onto L2 ball .125 for a uniform <=.125 absolute per-order score shift across all states. Zero d or identical feature vectors gives no update; invalid, absent or insufficiently verified label gives no trained artifact. Never tune on the one example.
predictions: Retain old/new all-menu probabilities and ranks, A/B relative log odds and change, observed label and directional agreement. Tie in prediction = tie, not correct. Transfer may disagree; report unaudited/missing leaf as unavailable. No promotion, deployment, claim of generalization or match win under any result. A lone fit root cannot support such claims.
implementation_checks: Explicit finite-difference gradient at first step
Zero init recovers all original probabilities, then both sums normalize; exact physical support preserved
Equal U gives no update; opposite sign at same input reverses the gradient and new-vs-old log-odds shift; swapping both A/B and outcomes is invariant
Identical pre-action representations cannot produce opposite logits; no fit if all action representations coincide
Freeze fitted weights and all pre-outcome test predictions before joining any transfer label
